scripts.generate: bun run src/build-registry.ts && bun run src/build-infrastructure.ts && bun run src/build-readiness.ts
scripts.build:client: bun run generate && vite build && bun run scripts/strip-index-html.ts
scripts.build:vscode: bun run generate && vite build --config vite.vscode.config.ts
scripts.build:plugin: bun run generate && bun run scripts/build-plugin.ts
scripts.package:vscode: bun run build:vscode && cd vscode && pnpm install --silent --prefer-offline && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out .
scripts.publish:vscode: bash ../shared/agent-config/scripts/deploy-guarded.sh --check && bun run build:vscode && cd vscode && pnpm install --silent --prefer-offline && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce publish --no-dependencies
scripts.deploy: bash ../shared/agent-config/scripts/deploy-guarded.sh --check && bun run generate && vite build && bun run scripts/strip-index-html.ts && bun x wrangler deploy
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:vscode && bun run build:plugin
